originalQuestion: Why does the category report count one basket twice?
clarifiedQuestion: For items created in January 2025 UTC, which ten categories appeared in the most distinct orders?
humanResponse:
An order with two items in one category counts once for that category. An order spanning two categories counts once in each.

```sql
SELECT p.category, COUNT(DISTINCT i.order_id) AS orders
FROM `tv_thelook.order_items` AS i
JOIN `tv_thelook.products` AS p ON p.id = i.product_id
WHERE i.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00 UTC'
  AND i.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01 00:00:00 UTC'
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY orders DESC, p.category ASC
LIMIT 10
```
